notes.note: Searching a non-existent member id shows, in the Member Search panel: "No member record found for 99999999. Verify the number and try again." with a "Return to Member Search" link. Observed directly.
Open Sub-Account form: submitting blank shows "Please correct the following:" with "Account Type is required.", "Account Nickname is required.", "Initial Deposit is required." Observed directly.
Initial Deposit hint reads "USD, minimum 25.00"; submitting 10.00 returns "Initial Deposit must be at least 25.00." Observed directly.

Flow: login -> Servicing Console home -> "Member Servicing — look up a member record" -> Member Search (Member ID) -> Member Record with Share Accounts grid and "Open Sub-Account" button -> Open Sub-Account form (Account Type dropdown: Savings/Checking/Money Market/Certificate, Account Nickname, Initial Deposit) -> "Continue to Review" -> Review panel (Cancel or "Confirm and Open Account") -> "Request Completed / Sub-account opened successfully." with Confirmation Number, New Account Number, Account Type, Account Nickname, Opening Deposit. The Review step is irreversible once confirmed (opens a real account on the record).
Bad sign-in credentials wording was NOT probed (would have destroyed the authenticated session mid-task); the declared detector for it is inferred, not observed.

finish.name: Open member sub-account
finish.description: Signs in to the Meridian core servicing console, looks up a member by Member ID, and opens a new share sub-account with the given account type, nickname and opening deposit, confirming through the review step. Returns the confirmation number, the new account number and the recorded type/nickname/deposit. If the member id does not exist, or the deposit is below the institution minimum, that is reported as a business outcome instead of an account being opened. Note: confirming is an irreversible change to the member record.
